name: add_tests_php_title_case_small_words
description: Write PHPUnit tests for a title-case formatter that lowercases small words except at the first/last position; mutation-checked (first-word exception dropped, last-word exception dropped, small-word check inverted)
prompts: TitleCase::format(string $s): string in src/TitleCase.php (already correct - do not modify it) title-cases a lowercase, space-separated string: every word is capitalized EXCEPT the small words a/an/the/of/in/on/and/or/to, which stay lowercase - UNLESS that small word is the FIRST or LAST word of the string, in which case it is capitalized too. Write PHPUnit tests at exactly tests/TitleCaseTest.php (class TitleCaseTest extends PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase, using assertSame with exact expected strings) with at least 4 test methods covering: an all-regular-words input, a small word appearing in the MIDDLE (stays lowercase), a small word as the FIRST word (capitalized), and a small word as the LAST word (capitalized). Begin the file with `require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/TitleCase.php';`.

setup_files.src/TitleCase.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class TitleCase
{
    private const SMALL_WORDS = ['a', 'an', 'the', 'of', 'in', 'on', 'and', 'or', 'to'];

    // Title-cases a lowercase, space-separated $s: every word is capitalized
    // EXCEPT small words (SMALL_WORDS), which stay lowercase - UNLESS the
    // small word is the first or last word, in which case it is always
    // capitalized too.
    public static function format(string $s): string
    {
        $words = explode(' ', $s);
        $last = count($words) - 1;
        $out = [];
        foreach ($words as $i => $word) {
            if ($word === '') {
                $out[] = $word;
                continue;
            }
            $isSmall = in_array($word, self::SMALL_WORDS, true);
            if ($isSmall && $i !== 0 && $i !== $last) {
                $out[] = $word;
            } else {
                $out[] = strtoupper($word[0]) . substr($word, 1);
            }
        }
        return implode(' ', $out);
    }
}

test_setup_files.mutation_check.php:
<?php
// PHP mutation harness (the php sandbox image has no python3).
$impl = __DIR__ . '/src/TitleCase.php';
$src = file_get_contents($impl);

$anchors = [
    "if (\$isSmall && \$i !== 0 && \$i !== \$last) {",
    "\$isSmall = in_array(\$word, self::SMALL_WORDS, true);",
];
foreach ($anchors as $a) {
    if (substr_count($src, $a) !== 1) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "protected impl was modified (anchor missing: $a)\n");
        exit(2);
    }
}

function run_tests(): int {
    $code = 0;
    passthru('phpunit tests/TitleCaseTest.php', $code);
    return $code;
}

$rc = run_tests();
if ($rc !== 0) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit $rc)\n");
    exit(1);
}

$mutants = [
    // small-word exception dropped for the FIRST word too (only last-word
    // guarded) - "the lord of the rings" would wrongly keep "the" lowercase
    ["if (\$isSmall && \$i !== 0 && \$i !== \$last) {", "if (\$isSmall && \$i !== \$last) {"],
    // small-word exception dropped for the LAST word
    ["if (\$isSmall && \$i !== 0 && \$i !== \$last) {", "if (\$isSmall && \$i !== 0) {"],
    // small-word check inverted entirely (small words capitalized, common
    // words left alone)
    ["\$isSmall = in_array(\$word, self::SMALL_WORDS, true);", "\$isSmall = !in_array(\$word, self::SMALL_WORDS, true);"],
];

$exit = 0;
foreach ($mutants as $i => [$old, $new]) {
    file_put_contents($impl, str_replace($old, $new, $src));
    $rc = run_tests();
    if ($rc === 0) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "mutation " . ($i + 1) . " SURVIVED: tests pass on a broken impl\n");
        $exit = 1;
    }
    file_put_contents($impl, $src);
}

if ($exit === 0) {
    echo "PASS (tests pass on correct impl and kill all " . count($mutants) . " mutants)\n";
}
exit($exit);

reference_solution.tests/TitleCaseTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/TitleCase.php';

final class TitleCaseTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testCapitalizesRegularWords(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('Hello World', \App\TitleCase::format('hello world'));
    }

    public function testSmallWordInMiddleStaysLowercase(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('Lord of the Rings', \App\TitleCase::format('lord of the rings'));
    }

    public function testSmallWordAsFirstWordIsCapitalized(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('The Lord of Rings', \App\TitleCase::format('the lord of rings'));
    }

    public function testSmallWordAsLastWordIsCapitalized(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('King of The', \App\TitleCase::format('king of the'));
    }
}

files.tests/TitleCaseTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/TitleCase.php';

final class TitleCaseTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testReturnsString(): void
    {
        $this->assertIsString(\App\TitleCase::format('hello world'));
    }

    public function testFirstCharUppercase(): void
    {
        $result = \App\TitleCase::format('hello world');
        $this->assertSame('H', $result[0]);
    }

    public function testNotEmpty(): void
    {
        $this->assertNotEmpty(\App\TitleCase::format('a b'));
    }

    public function testSameWordCount(): void
    {
        $result = \App\TitleCase::format('the lord of the rings');
        $this->assertSame(5, count(explode(' ', $result)));
    }
}
